Operational Briefing

️ Step-by-Step Strategy

1. Vault Detonation: As Michael, aim at the hostages to force them back into the break room. Use the cell phone to detonate the plastic C4 charges placed by Trevor.

2. Taking the Loot: Collect the cash bundles in the corner of the bunker. Upon exiting, a guard will tackle Michael; switch characters to Trevor and take him down with a well-placed shot.

3. Exterior Shootout in the Snow: Upon detonating the back door, you will step out into a brutal blizzard surrounded by state police patrol cars. Advance along the left flank using the armored vans as cover.

4. The Getaway and the Railroad Crossing: After taking down the officers by the gate, get into the getaway vehicle. When the driver is shot dead, take the wheel as Michael, turn right bypassing the police roadblock and accelerate toward the train tracks. Operational Briefing

  • ›Playable Protagonists: Michael, Franklin, and Trevor.
  • ›Tactical Objective: Repel the joint FIB and Merryweather assault at the Murrieta Heights metal foundry, split up to assassinate the trio's sworn enemies across Los Santos (Wei Cheng with a Sticky Bomb, Stretch with a melee attack, and Steve Haines with a sniper headshot), and abduct Devin Weston from his Tongva Hills mansion to finish the story at Raton Canyon.

The Last Stand (The Foundry Ambush)

  • ›The Trap: Using a false tip about melting down the Union Depository gold, Lester lures both FIB strike teams and a Merryweather battalion into the Murrieta Heights foundry.
  • ›Holding the Interior: Switch between all three characters along the upper catwalks and main floor to repel waves of tactical units. When Lamar radios from outside needing backup and Trevor stops responding on comms, use Michael to push through the smelting floor and cover Trevor.
  • ›Clearing the Yard: Move outside to wipe out the remaining FIB agents, Merryweather reinforcements, and attack helicopters surrounding the industrial yard.

Settling Scores (The Hit List)

  • ›Dividing the Targets: After surviving the foundry siege, the trio decides to tie up every loose end by taking out each other's rivals so the hits cannot be traced:
  • ›Michael → Stretch (Harold Joseph): Head to the B.J. Smith Recreation Center in Chamberlain Hills. Clear out the Ballas guards and, to secure the Stretched Out gold objective, walk up to Stretch and kill him with a melee attack (fist, baton, or knife) rather than shooting him.
  • ›Franklin → Wei Cheng: Drive to the Pacific Bluffs Country Club. Toss a Sticky Bomb onto the central limousine of the Triad convoy before they pull away and detonate it to kill Wei Cheng and earn Cheng Reaction.
  • ›Trevor → Steve Haines: Travel to Del Perro Pier, where Haines is filming an episode of The Underbelly of Paradise on the Ferris wheel. Snipe him cleanly in the head inside his gondola from a distance to earn Lead Lobotomy, then escape the police.
  • ›The Billionaire: Finally, Trevor storms Devin Weston's mansion in Tongva Hills, neutralizes his Merryweather guards, stuffs Weston into the trunk of his own Truffade Adder, and drives him to the cliffs near Paleto Cove / Raton Canyon. All three protagonists reunite at sunset and push the car off the cliff into the ocean, bringing GTA V's canonical story to a triumphant close.
